title: Spicy Gluten-Free Omelette
description: A simple and flavorful omelette recipe, perfect for a quick breakfast or snack. This dish is gluten-free and packed with spicy goodness.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together. Add the spicy, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat and add the eggs.
Cook the eggs until the edges start to set, then add the shredded cheese and sliced green chilies.
Use a spatula to gently fold the omelette in half, and cook for another minute.
Slide the omelette out of the pan onto a plate and serve hot.
